user.title: Scan for Tuya WiFi Devices
user.description:
This will scan your local network for Tuya WiFi devices.

**Note:** This scanner will find the Device ID, IP address, and protocol version. You'll still need to get the Local Key from the Tuya IoT platform to actually connect to devices.

Click Submit to start scanning...

scan.description: Scanning for Tuya devices on your network. This may take 30-60 seconds...
